question: Did you read CLAUDE.md? If not, explain the reason in detail in the answer field. If yes, also state that you read it in the answer field.
answer: Yes, I read CLAUDE.md in full. It was provided as project instructions (system context) at the start of this session. I used it as the primary baseline for understanding: (1) the Lattice story lifecycle and init_check_set procedure, (2) the legacy .koala/.lattice migration architecture and LEGACY_KOALA_DIR pattern, (3) the dispatch alias deprecation policy (CLAUDE.md line 874 documents story_dispatch/finding_dispatch as deprecated aliases), (4) the signature salt architecture and why renaming koala-*-integrity-v1 salts would be catastrophic, and (5) the docs-drift gate and test:koala-residue gate mentioned in the checklist items. I cross-referenced CLAUDE.md claims against actual source code when verifying factual accuracy (e.g., found that CLAUDE.md says story_dispatch is a deprecated alias but command-policy.ts still marks it as supported).
